name: assetlib
description: Assetlib plugins for coding agents: a read-only audit of an app's artwork, and a connected plugin that reads and drafts a workspace's image placements through Assetlib's MCP server.

plugins.name: assetlib-audit
plugins.description: Inventory an app's PNG, JPEG, and WebP artwork locally: measured bytes, exact duplicates, oversized candidates, and reference hints. Then plan a bounded artwork migration that keeps bundled fallbacks.

plugins.name: assetlib
plugins.description: Connect your coding agent to an Assetlib workspace: see what each image placement shows in draft, staging and production, its code references and release history, and prepare image changes as a draft. Publishing stays with a person in the console.
